newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Motorola sells unit to Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Motorola sells unit to Telecom.

text.p: Motorola Inc's New Zealand branch said on Tuesday it had sold its service provider Motorola Cellular Services to Telecom Corp of New Zealand Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
Motorola Cellular Services, a Telecom Accredited Service Provider (TASP), buys ceullar air time from Telecom and resells it to Motorola customers.
Motorola New Zealand said it would operate its remaining business from a new facility at Mount Wellington, Auckland.
Motorola became involved in re-selling as at TASP to help develop the New Zealand cellular market in its early stages.

"With the New Zealand market having passed 500,000 analog and GSM users, we believe it is an opportune time to concentrate on our cellular phone business," general manager Dianne Sussex said. Telecom will continue to operate the business.
